name: comp-123
title: Show More Toggle Button
blurb: Ghost button toggling between 'Show more' and 'Show less' with icon swap.
description: A stateful ghost button that toggles text and chevron icon direction. Uses aria-expanded and aria-controls for accessibility.
use_when: Expanding/collapsing content sections with a clear toggle affordance.
avoid_when: When animation or smooth transitions are desired.
a11y: Uses aria-expanded to announce state and aria-controls to link to the controlled content. Icons are aria-hidden.
